instruction: Can you help me install the Live Server extension for Visual Studio Code to enable live preview of web pages?

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Live Server extension (ritwickdey.LiveServer) in VSCode. The evaluator verifies installation by running 'code --list-extensions' and checking if the output contains the Live Server extension ID.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the installation of Live Server extension
Getter uses standard 'code --list-extensions' command which properly extracts VSCode extension installation status
Metric function correctly implements string containment check to verify extension ID presence
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly (not nested in expected wrapper)
Expected value 'ritwickdey.LiveServer' is the correct official extension ID
Coverage is complete: instruction asks to install extension, evaluator verifies it is installed
Edge cases handled correctly: returns 1.0 when installed, 0.0 when not installed
Data flow is semantically correct: command output -> getter extracts string -> metric checks containment
